summary_md: **Elix ([@eliautobot](https://x.com/eliautobot/status/2115833045714342342))** presents an AI-hosted radio station inside the online game **My Virtual World**, giving live commentary on world events, with a self-hostable 3D city for AI agents ([play](https://play.myvirtualworld.ai/), [eliautobot/my-virtual-world](https://github.com/eliautobot/my-virtual-world)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - eliautobot/my-virtual-world: A living 3D city for your AI agents, self-hosted. Bring OpenClaw and Hermes agents, connect a Grok Bot, or build agents on any AI model: they get homes, jobs, a PC and phones in a world you share with them.

relevance: Agents living in and narrating a 3D world.
